methods.name: for_subject
methods.summary: Transforms this narrowing operation to apply to a different subject.

methods.name: rebase_onto_subject
methods.summary: Rebase a narrowing operation onto an expression that is already the subject.

methods.name: set_allow_never_collapse
methods.summary: Mark every facet subject in this op tree as allowed to collapse a non-union base to `Never`. Used on the negation of a match arm so that subtracting a fully-matched member soundly reduces the subject (see `FacetSubject`).

methods.name: strip_placeholders
methods.summary: Removes all `Placeholder` operations from this narrow op tree. Used when all sub-patterns of a class pattern are irrefutable, meaning the Placeholders (added by `and_all` for unmerged names) are spurious and would incorrectly block negativ…

items.name: NarrowSource
items.summary: Indicates where an isinstance-style narrow operation originated from. This determines whether validation needs to happen during narrowing.

items.name: identifier_and_chain_for_expr
items.summary: Given an expression, determine whether it is a chain of properties (attribute/concrete index) rooted at a name, and if so, return the name and the chain of properties. For example: x.y.[0].z

items.name: identifier_and_chain_prefix_for_expr
items.summary: Similar to identifier_and_chain_for_expr, except if we encounter a non-concrete subscript in the chain we only return the prefix before that location. For example: w.x[y].z -> w.x
